resources.string: The Together Trail
Your everyday walks. One shared adventure.
Discover five places together. Walk at your own pace, wherever you are.
One complete original adventure. One sponsor covers the group.
Every current member can join without another purchase. The organiser starts the adventure.
Shared adventure goal
Confirm the total before starting. Weekly goals remain unchanged.
Your contribution starts from your joining sync. Earlier steps are not added.
Sam\'s commitment becomes zero. Alex\'s commitment stays the same. Earned steps are kept.
A trail worth remembering
Five chapters, one shared achievement. Your earned keepsake stays available after Premium ends.
Sharing is optional. No private member details are included by default.
Five places to discover
The Opening Path
Beyond the gate, the path bends out of sight. You do not need to see the whole trail to begin. Your separate walks have brought the group to its first clearing. There is room here for every pace.
What made it easier to get moving this week?
An open gate leads to a winding path between two trees.
The Quiet Grove

The trees gather close and the trail grows quiet. A bench waits in the shade. Some days bring longer walks; others need a pause. Both belong in a journey you can keep returning to. The grove will still be here when you are ready.
What would make next week feel manageable?
A bench rests beneath green trees beside a quiet path.
The Shared Bridge

A stream crosses the trail, and a broad bridge carries it onward. You reached this place through different days, different walks and different rhythms. None of those walks had to look the same to bring you here together.
Is there someone you would like to thank for joining you?
A broad wooden bridge crosses a gentle stream.
The Wide Horizon

The trees open and the view stretches beyond the hills. The trail behind you is longer than it looked at the beginning. There is no need to hurry through the last part. You already know how to return, one ordinary walk at a time.
Which small part of this journey would you like to keep?
A path opens onto gentle hills beneath a wide amber sky.
The Lantern Clearing

At the end of the trail, lanterns light a circle beneath the evening sky. This place holds all the walks that brought you here: short ones, long ones and the days you returned after a break. You finished this trail together. That is worth remembering.
What would you like your next shared adventure to feel like?
Warm lanterns light a circular clearing beneath an evening sky.
